Name: Spirit's Eve Themed Recipe Pack
Author: YarnGuitar31415
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Adds 3 new Spirit's Eve Themed recipes such as a pomegranate tea with whipped cream, a cookie that looks like an eye, a pumpkin cone ice cream. Also adds unique dialogue when gifted for certain NPC's. This is my first mod I've created and I have no prior experience so I apologize for any possible errors! 

Recipe: Pumpkin Cone - unlocks on 3rd of fall via mail when 3 hearts friendship with Jodi
Recipe: Pomegranate tea- unlocks on 5th of fall via mail when 3 hearts friendship with Leah
Recipe: Eye Cookie - unlocks on 7th of fall via mail when 3 hearts friendship with Gus
